name: tiktok-live-ball-arena
description: TikTok Live Ball Arena — interactive live game overlay (OBS 1080x1920)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @arena/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @arena/server" "npm run dev -w @arena/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @arena/shared && npm run build -w @arena/server && npm run selftest -w @arena/server && npm run build -w @arena/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @arena/shared && npm run dev -w @arena/server
